description: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics publishes the 2013 Population and Housing Census as a set of thematic PDF reports on its downloads page. The housing and household characteristics report gives, by local government area and urban or rural residence, the main source of light, cooking fuel, toilet facilities, solid waste disposal and collection, and main source of water, with a water series back to 1983; 47.9 percent of households used electricity as their main source of light, up from 27.8 percent in 2003. The compounds and buildings report counts compounds and building structures by area and describes them by rooms, exterior wall, roofing and floor material, functional use and permanency, with 43.8 percent of structures permanent and 23.8 percent non-permanent. Coverage is national by local government area. Format and access: free PDFs, no registration; a preliminary report of the 2024 census is also posted. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables are percentages in PDFs; the microdata catalogue link failed with an expired certificate; headline indicators on the site mix census and survey sources. Simulation uses: building fragility by material and permanency for flood and wind damage, and electrification and water access by area. Related records: none for Gambia censuses in the catalogue.
